g.text: Ground facts and memory in time and access
Scope the question and keep changing beliefs attached to dated evidence, access and correction history.

Bridgewater’s Vault organizes research by source, market, country, concept and discussed period. Apply entitlements and time constraints before synthesis. A correct answer to a neighboring period, entity or definition is still a failure of the requested task.

Citadel Securities separates reported project status from evidence-based status, keeps historical records, ages claims and compares earlier predictions with later outcomes. Models propose updates; code and people decide what enters the record. This is richer than retrieving the latest matching sentence.

A quiet source can mean a collection problem rather than inactivity. Preserve last observed time, source health and correction history; unknown is not zero. Our combined evidence contract adds versioned definitions and as-of snapshots, without claiming a single firm implemented every field.
Sources: Bridgewater · Citadel Securities | Reviewed October 25, 2026
